cues: She is waiting outside: isn't she?
They were not invited: the statement is negative, so were they?
The bus left early has no auxiliary at all, so we supply did: didn't it?
Sita teaches at Amar Campus: doesn't she?
And a negative tag is always contracted: isn't he, never is not he.
